spec.name: Boot Rain
spec.notes: Boot intro: random-coloured drops falling top-down for 4 s, then the boot screen reveals. Any press skips it — the failsafe cap in the player is 15 s regardless.

spec.name: Error Spin
spec.notes: Error during-loop: a red comet circling the 6×6 ring around the centre block. Fixed hue 0 (red) on purpose — the error screen signals, it does not entertain.

spec.name: Pulse Sweep
spec.notes: General-purpose ambient: a soft band sweeping the surface, new random direction and colour every sweep. Meant as a during-loop on layer 'under' so bound pads stay readable.
